s: Ezeh melakot asurim beyom tob ubo t"v seipim: sheshet yamim ellu, shehen rishon ushebii shel pesach, vechag hashshabuot, verosh hashshana, verishon ushemini shel chag hassukkot, hen hanniqraim "yamim tobim". Vekol haoseh "meleket aboda" beechad mehen — hare zeh loqeh min hattora, shenneemar "kol meleket aboda lo taasu". Vekol hashshobet bahen mi"meleket aboda" — hare zeh qiyyem mitzvat aseh, shehare neemar bahen "shabbaton", kelomar shebut.

Umahu "meleket aboda"? Kol melaka sheenah naaset beokel o mashqeh, veen bimlaka zo tzorek laakila ushetiyya, kegon shekkibba et hanner, o shebbana, o shechapar, vekol kayyotze baellu. Abal kol melaka hannaaset beokel o bemashqeh, kegon haqqetzira, vehaddisha, vehaimmur, vehazzeriyya, vehabberira, vehattechina, vehaharqada, vehallisha, vehaapiyya, vehashshechita, vehabbishshul, vehabbetzira, vehassechita, vehatztzida, vehahotzaa mereshut lirshut, kol ellu, kevan shehen naasin begup haokel umashqeh, ukesheadam neheneh mehaokel umashqeh — hare neheneh miggup hammelaka atzmah (hannaaset letzorek akila, o lishar tzorek yom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer), lepikak niqrain kol melakot ellu vekayyotze bahen: "meleket okel nepesh", shehattora hittira laasotah letzorek akilat yom tob, shenneemar "ak asher yeakel lekol nepesh hu lebaddo yeaseh lakem". Veken hahabara, ap al pi sheenah naaset begup haokel ap im hi letzorek akila, shehare hu mabir esh beetzim umebashshel alehem, mikkol maqom, kevan shehi metaqqenet et haokel, shehare inyan hahabara hu hotzaat haesh, o shemmarbeh haesh, vegup haesh zo shehotzi o shehirba hi hamtaqqenet umebashshelet et haokel — hare gam hi biklal "meleket okel nepesh".

Veqibbelu chakamim shekkol melakot "okel nepesh" mittok shehittira hattora laasotan letzorek akilat yom tob — hutteru legamre apillu shello letzorek akilat yom tob, ubilbad sheyyehe bahen qetzat tzorek yom tob, ap al pi sheeno tzorek akila, ella tzorek hanaat haggup, o tzorek mitzva oberet shezzemannah bo bayyom, shehi gam ken kahanaat haggup leinyan zeh. Vehu shettehe hanaat haggup zo shaveh lekol nepesh adam miyyisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"a vetaqay"b.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheggupo neheneh miggup hammelaka atzmah hannaaset letzorek yom tob, kegon shemmotzi chapatzayv mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim shehu tzarik lehishtammesh bahen birshut harabbim, veken hammadliq et hanner kede lehishtammesh leoro tashmishim hatztzerikim lo bo bayyom ap al pi sheen bahem tzorek akila, vekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal im en gupo neheneh beyom tob miggup hammelaka atzmah ella middabar shennitqan venitkashsher lahanaat haadam al yede asiyyat hammelaka, kegon shemmetaqqen shappud litzlot bo, sheen gupo neheneh miggup hashshappud ella mehatztzali shennitzleh bo, o shemmebaqqea qora leetzim daqqim meod lehatztzit bahem haur tachat qederato, sheen gupo neheneh miggup haetzim shennaasa bahem melaka ella mehattabshil shennitbashshel al yede melaka zo, kol ellu vekayyotze bahen ap al pi sheoseh otan letzorek akilat yom tob, mikkol maqom, kevan sheen hammelaka naaset begup ha"okel nepesh" ella bedabar hammakshiro laakila — hare hen niqrain "makshire okel nepesh", sheasur laasotan beyom tob min hattora apillu im hu beinyan sheim lo ken yapsid akilato legamre veyitanneh beyom tob, shenneemar "hu lebaddo yeaseh lakem", "hu" velo makshirayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemakshirim sheepshar laasotan meereb yom tob, kegon laasot shappud chadash, shehare epshar lo laasot meereb yom tob (vaapillu haya anus beereb yom tob velo haya lo penay laasot hashshappud, mikkol maqom haya epshar lo laasoto kamma yamim qodem yom tob), veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Abal makshirin shei epshar laasotan meereb yom tob, kegon letaqqen hashshappud shennishbar beyom tob, o apillu shennishbar beereb yom tob ella shello haya epshar lo letaqqeno bo bayyom mechamat ezeh ones gadol — muttar letaqqeno beyom tob, shenneemar "yeaseh lakem", vedareshu chakamim: "lakem" — lekol tzorkekem, lerabbot makshirin shei epshar laasotan meereb yom tob.

Vekol zeh bemakshirin, abal melakot "okel nepesh" atzman, ap al pi shehaya epshar lo laasotan meereb yom tob — muttar laasotan beyom tob min hattora. Abal middibre soperim kol melaka shehaya epshar lo laasotah meereb yom tob velo yihyeh bah hepsed velo chesron taam im hayeta naaset mibbeod yom, apillu shakach velo asaah, o shehaya tarud velo haya lo penay laasotah, mikkol maqom, kevan shello haya anus bedabar — asur laasotah beyom tob, ella im ken meshanneh qetzat baasiyyatah midderek hachol. Abal muttar lalush veleepot velishchot ulebashshel kedarko bechol, lepi sheim asa echad meellu meereb yom tob — yesh bekak hepsed o chesron taam, sheen lechem shennillosh veneepa hayyom kelechem shennillosh veneepa meetmol, velo tabshil shennitbashshel hayyom ketabshil shennitbashshel meetmol, velo basar shennishchat hayyom kebasar shennishchat meetmol. Veken muttar lehabir esh im rotzeh lehishtammesh baesh dabar shello haya epshar lo laasoto meereb yom tob belo hepsed vechissaron, o kede lehair, o bishar inyanim sheyyitbaaru besimman tqy"a vetaqay"d.

Abal asur lebashshel beyom tob debarim sheen bahem hepsed velo chesron taam im haya mebashshelan meereb yom tob, kegon perot haybeshim shehem tobim yoter keshennitbashshelu meetmol. Veken asur lalush beyom tob dabar sheen bo shum qilqul taam im haya nillosh meereb yom tob, kegon mah sheqqorin bilshon ashkenaz vevrimezli"n ubeartzenu laqshi"n, shehayshanim yoter tobim, veken kol kayyotze bazeh.

Velama aseru dabar zeh? Gezera shemma yimmana adam millaasot kol melakot "okel nepesh" sheepshar lo laasotan meereb yom tob veyannichen laasot otan beyom tob shehu yom batel, venimtza yom tob kullo holek baasiyyat otan melakot, veyitbattel missimchat yom tob.

Umizzeh hattaam lo aseru hahotzaa, ap shehaya epshar lo laasotah meereb yom tob, velamma lo asaruha — kede leharbot besimchat yom tob veyolik veyabi kol mah sheyyirtzeh veyashlim chapatzayv, velo yihyeh kemo sheyyadayv asurot.

Veken mizzeh hattaam shello yitbattel missimchat yom tob aseru chakamim haqqetzira, vehaddisha, vehaimmur, vehazzeriyya, uberirat mine tebua shedderek labor otam harbeh beyachad, vehattechina shel kol minim hannitchanim barechayim shedderek litchon otam harbeh beyachad, vehaharqada, vehattelisha mehammechubbar shehi toledet haqqetzira, usechitat perot shehi toledet disha shemmepareq dabar miggiddulo, kol melakot ellu vetoledotehem, vekol dabar hanneesar bishbilam beshabbat middibre soperim shemma yabo laasot hammelaka atzmah — asur gam beyom tob apillu al yede shinnuy, vaapillu lo haya epshar laasotam meereb yom tob, lepi shekkol melakot hallalu darkan leheasot harbeh beyachad beyom echad letzorek akilat yamim harbeh, shehare derek haadam liqtzor kol sadehu beyachad velibtzor kol anabayv beyachad, uleammer veladush velibror velitchon harbeh tebuot beyachad, uleraqqed qemach harbeh, velidrok anabim vezetim harbeh beyachad, chashu chakamim im melakot ellu yihyu muttarin lo — yitrach beyom tob gam letzorek hachol, kevan shedderek laasotan letzorek yamim rabbim, velo yihyeh lo penay lehitasseq besimchat yom tob. Veken aseru hatztzida, lepi sheal harob en derek laasotah letzorek hayyom ella letzorek machar, lepi sheen haadam somek al hassapeq shello letaqqen maakalo ad sheyyatzud, shehare eno yodea shemma taaleh metzudato reqanit, ella iqqarah miyyom lachabero hu. Veken aseru chalibat habbehema, lepi sheggam hi naaset letzorek akilat yamim rabbim, shehare adam choleb kol tzono beyachad. Abal hittiru shechiqat hammelach utebalin uberirat mine qitniyyot, lepi sheen derek laasotan harbeh beyachad letzorek yamim rabbim, ella mah shehu tzarik mehem lebo bayyom bilbad, ella shekkol sheepshar laasoto meereb yom tob asur laasoto beyom tob ki im al yede shinnuy, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"d vetaq"y.
Kol sheasur laasoto beyom tob — asur lomar lenokri laasoto, shehaamira lenokri hi shebut beyom tob kemo beshabbat.

En motziin massa al habbehema beyom tob, veen hattaam mishshum shebitat behemto shemmotzia hammassa mereshut lirshut, shehare ap haadam beatzmo muttar lehotzi beyom tob mereshut lirshut, ella shechakamim aseru lehotzi massa al habbehema beyom tob mishshum zilzul yom tob, shello yaaseh bo kederek shehu oseh bechol, veod sheen mishtammeshin bebaale chayyim kol iqqar, kemo sheyyitbaer.
Keshem sheasur lehishtammesh bebaale chayyim ubimchubbar laqqarqa beshabbat kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"h veshal"v — kak asur beyom tob.

Kebar bearnu behilkot shabbat deen issur muqtzeh beshabbat ella muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis shennitbaer besimman (sh"[ch], o muqtzeh mechamat issur shennidcha bide adam ben hashshemashot, kegon ner shehidliqu bo beshabbat, o muqtzeh keen gerogarot vetzimmuqin shemmaalin otan laggag leyabbeshan veadam massiach dato mehem mippene sheen reuyim laakila ad leachar zeman merubbeh, abal shear kol dabar sherauy lehishtammesh mimmennu ezeh tashmish — muttar letaltelo beshabbat, apillu muqtzeh mechamat mius o mechamat sheomed lischora vekayyotze bazeh muttar letaltelo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y ayyen sham. Abal beyom tob nechlequ happoseqim, yesh omerim dekol shemmuttar letaltelo o leoklo beshabbat muttar letaltelo veken leoklo beyom tob, vekol sheasur letaltelo o leoklo beshabbat asur leoklo uletaltelo beyom tob, ella im ken metaltelo letzorek akilat debar hetter, deaz muttar letaltelo, kemo shehutteru kol hammelakot letzorek akila, ayyen simman taq"[t]. Veyesh omerim shebben muqtzeh mechamat issur shello nidcha bide adam ben hashshemashot, ben muqtzeh mechamat mius o mechamat sheomed lischora shennitbaer besimman sh"y, o dabar shehikniso laotzar veen dato lehistappeq mimmennu ad leachar zeman merubbeh — asur letaltelam beyom tob, ella im ken metaltelam letzorek akilat debar hetter, mippene sheyyom tob qal mishshabbat lepikak aseru bo hammuqtzeh kede shello yabou lezalzel bo. Ulepi dibrehem behema haomedet lachalabah vetarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim veshor haomed lacharisha — asur leshochotan beyom tob ad sheyyakin otan meereb yom tob, dehaynu sheyyachshob alehen laakila, kemo sheyyitbaer, veken kol kayyotze baellu. Veyesh omerim dekol muqtzeh shemmuttar beshabbat muttar beyom tob, abal kol nolad asur ben beshabbat ben beyom tob. Umahu nolad? Dabar sheeno rauy hayyom lemah shehaya rauy beben hashshemashot, kegon keli shennishbar beshabbat o beyom tob veeno yakol lehishtammesh besheber hakkeli mah shehaya yakol lehishtammesh keshehakkeli haya shalem ella tashmish acher, kegon kele mashqin shennishberu o niqqebu beyom tob o beshabbat veeno yakol lehishtammesh beshibrehem mashqin kemiqqodem ella okalin o debarim acherim — asur letaltel hashshebarim beshabbat o beyom tob shennishberu bo, mippene shettashmish zeh nolad beshabbat o beyom tob veetmol lo haya hakkeli omed umukan letashmish zeh. Veken atzamot shennitparequ min habbasar beshabbat o beyom tob ap al pi shehen reuyin lakkeleb — asur letaltelam bo bayyom shennitparequ, shehare etmol hayu mechubbarin labbasar venechshabin kebasar atzmo sheomed laakilat adam vehayyom shennitparequ mehabbasar omedin lakkelabim, vahare zeh nolad. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir benolad beyom tob, kevan sheyyesh omerim sheapillu muqtzeh asur bo. Abal beshabbat yesh lehattir apillu nolad, ki ken iqqar. Abal bemuqtzeh nohagin lehaqel bimdinot ellu ap beyom tob. Vehammachmir beyom tob — tabo alayv beraka.

Kol muqtzeh shehaqtzaato enah ella mechamat machashabto shel haadam shehissiach dato milleoklo umillehishtammesh bo, kegon behema haomedet lachalabah, shehaqtzaatah beyom tob enah ella mechamat sheen dato aleha laakila (veayyen besimman tq"h yitbaer leka deyesh napquta mehalaka zo apillu ledidan dimqilinan bemuqtzeh apillu beyom tob), lepikak im chishsheb aleha meereb yom tob laakila ap al pi shello hotzi bispatayv — hare hi mukenet laakila al yede machashaba zo, umuttar leshochotah beyom tob ap lehaoserin muqtzeh beyom tob, lepi shemmachashaba zo motzia miyyad machashaba harishona, veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Abal kol muqtzeh shehaqtzaato baa lo al yede maaseh bene adam, kegon teenim vaanabim sheheelan laggag leyabbeshan sheyyeasu gerogarot vetzimmuqim, im hem beinyan shemmoelet lahem hakana mibbeod yom, kegon shekkebar hen reuyim laakila lemiqtzat bene adam sheddatam yapeh, ella shellemiqtzat bene adam enan reuyim laakila, ulekak tzarik lehazminam mibbeod yom, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y, veken shear mine perot sheheelan laggag leyabbeshan, vetzarik lehazminam mibbeod yom lehaoserim muqtzeh beyom tob, hazmana vahakana zo enah bemachashaba bilbad sheyyachshob alehem laakila, ella tzarik laasot bahem hakana gemura al yede maaseh (dehaynu sheyyeshaer bedato meereb yom tob kamma yitztarek littol mehem beyom tob) umeyached lo maqom echad betok happerot, shemmeoto maqom bilbad yittol perot beyom tob, veyirshom (perush sheyyaaseh simman) oto hammaqom bitchillato ubesopo, veyomar: "mikkan vead kan ani okel beyom tob". Abal im eno roshem meereb yom tob, ap al pi sheamar: "mikkan ani okel lemachar" — en amira zo motzia otam mide haqtzaatan shehayeta al yede maaseh, dehaynu sheheelan beyadayv leyabbeshan, veal yede haalaa zo huqtzu meakila.

Vahakana gemura zo sheyyesh bah maaseh — asur laasot beyom tob rishon kede leekol mehapperot beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot, ap al pi sheim abar vaasaah hoilu maasayv umuttar leekol mehapperot beyom tob sheni, shehare lo hinhigu chakamim et bene haggola laasot yom tob sheni ella mechamat hassapeq shemma yom rishon haya chol, venimtza shepperot hallalu hukenu mechol leyom tob, mikkol maqom lekattechilla i epshar laasot bahem hakana gemura beyom tob rishon, shehare i epshar lirshom perot hammuqtzin, shehem asurim betiltul beyom tob, vaapillu ligga bahen asur, ella im ken nogea bahen letzorek dabar hammuttar, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Abal kol muqtzeh sheen tzarik maaseh bahakanato, kegon behema haomedet lachalabah uperot haomedin lischora (shennitbaer besimman sh"y), lehaoserin muqtzeh beyom tob — muttar lehakin otam beyom rishon shel shene yamim tobim shel galuyyot kede leekol mehem lemachar beyom tob sheni. Velo aseru laasot shum hakana miyyom tob lachabero (kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"g) ella bedabar shemmetaqqeno umeqorbo lahanaat haadam al yede hakana zo, kegon lehaknis yayin min hammartep labbayit beyom tob rishon kede leqaddesh alayv belel yom tob sheni, sheim yom sheni hu chol — nimtza mekin beyom tob hanaat hachol. Abal hakanat hammuqtzeh mutteret beyom tob rishon bemimma napshak: im yom sheni hu qodesh vehammuqtzeh asur bo — hare yom rishon hu chol umekin mechol leyom tob, veim yom rishon hu qodesh — hare yom sheni hu chol umuqtzeh muttar bo veen tzarik lehakin kelal. Venimtza shehakana zo shemmekin beyom tob enah metaqqenet kelum veenah niqret hakana, kevan sheenah maksheret veenah meqarebet shum dabar lahanaat haadam, ha lema zeh domeh: lenotel min maakal shel hetter beyado beshabbat o beyom tob veomer "maakal zeh ani okel lemachar", sheen bekan issur hakana mishshabbat veyom tob lechol.
